mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, event_id, name, enabled, trigger_type, trigger_config::text AS trigger_config, exit_on_contact, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_event_nurture_sequence WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_event_nurture_sequence ( tenant_id, event_id, name, enabled, trigger_type, trigger_config, exit_on_contact, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{name}, #{enabled}, #{triggerType}, COALESCE(#{triggerConfig}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), #{exitOnContact}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW(), COALESCE(#{delFlag}, '0') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_event_nurture_step WHERE sequence_id = #{sequenceId}
